course.title: Coordinate Geometry and Differential Equations
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Answer any three of the followings:
i) Define order of the differential equation (D.E). Find the D.E of all circles passing through the origin and having their centre on the x-axis.
ii) Find the general solution of $( 1 - x ^ { 2 } ) { \frac { d y } { d x } } = x { \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } - 2 x y$
iii) Solve the D. $\operatorname { E } , { \frac { d y } { d x } } - 2 y = x y ^ { 3 }$
iv) Solve the D.E, $( x - 2 y + 1 ) d y = ( 3 x - y ) d x$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
